note_en: 不仅……还…… means "not only... but also...": 不仅为自己写歌，还为很多歌手创作了经典歌曲 "not only wrote songs for himself but also created classics for many singers." Notice that both parts come before their verbs and the subject is stated only once. 还 can be replaced by 也 or 而且, and 不仅 by the more colloquial 不但.
